rows.boundary: ICD6.0r5 requires a valid certificate under the network PKI and checks the Controller certificate Common Name against its UCI. The Certificate Guide distinguishes SDK,local testing,exercise and deployment certificates; deployment follows the deploying authority policy. This establishes source requirements,not installed credentials,verified trust,physical identity,permission for a task or current security certification. Virtual-component UCI suffixes do not imply a separate certificate for every virtual member. CMPT §4.1.2 separately requires date validity and nonrevocation. Its high/mid and low-level signer clauses respectively say ISA-approved and acceptable to the deploying organization. M-0004/L-0011 say ECDSA, while L-0013 is titled ECDSA Algorithm but says ECDH; L-0012 literally says the certificate is at least 384 bits long. These statements remain attributed without a repaired algorithm, inferred key-size field or current cryptographic recommendation. Controller Requirements 6.0r4: Controller registration compares the REQUEST ADD originating UCI with the certificate UCI before authorization. Certificate matching does not prove physical identity, completed certificate trust validation or permission to join.

rows.label: Connection-specific network participation lifecycle
rows.definition: A component follows phases of network participation for a Controller connection, with required exchanges and allowed transitions, separately from the continued existence of that connection.
display: Connection → Registration → Configuration → Operational → Deregistration → Disconnection; message-triggered transitions and renewal
rows.boundary: The six phases describe ISA participation, not physical asset life, equipment health or command execution. Periodic Status supports communication availability; missing Status does not prove physical failure. Registration renewal, nonresponsive/revived handling, deregistration and connection termination remain distinct; a connection may remain open. Figures illustrate typical and atypical paths, not an invented complete implementation. CMPT distinguishes pre-operational integration, pre-participation discovery/time setup and participation behavior. Its client-side role is the connection initiator; startup connection need is conditional, and connection attempts are at least five seconds apart. M-0032/L-0083–0088 gate Request/Event/Administrative transmission and silently discard early arrivals until the connected peer’s initial Status is received. This initial-Status operational marker remains separately attributed from the SDD initial-Config transition. A permitted IPL data exchange is not automatic permission for every ISA message or proof of hardware readiness. individual_correspondences.why: SOSA Sensor contributes a specific sensor-system boundary and modality to the proposed described sensing arrangement.
individual_correspondences.guard: Does not prove generic CSAPI System identity, ownership of deployed sensors or a mandatory domain superclass.

individual_correspondences.why: Source's generic System/SubSystem concept permits hierarchical systems without fixing one sensing domain root.
individual_correspondences.guard: Generic SOSA System is not always an instantiated physical sensing apparatus.

individual_correspondences.why: A SOSA Hardware Element is physical and can be a sensor constituent, with source-defined configuration bounds.
individual_correspondences.guard: Not every physical environmental probe or other equipment is a SOSA hardware element.

individual_correspondences.why: PIC, aperture, chassis/enclosure and power supply are documented SOSA hardware/infrastructure examples.
individual_correspondences.guard: SOSA hardware architecture is not universal sensor hardware inventory or mandatory chassis hierarchy.

individual_correspondences.why: SOSA Host Platform contributes concrete physical support/mounting context for a SOSA Sensor.
individual_correspondences.guard: Does not establish source-specific geolocation, site operator, sensor's own geometry or a software host.

individual_correspondences.why: SOSA Sensor Pod is an integral packaging and mounting case where sensor and pod boundaries overlap.
individual_correspondences.guard: Cannot always treat pod as external hosting platform or as a physically separate sensor.

individual_correspondences.why: SOSA External Interface crosses sensor boundary and may connect to host/environment.
individual_correspondences.guard: Not equivalent to a distinct externally cabled ClimaVue, SDI-12 connector, or all connected equipment.

individual_correspondences.why: Internal interfaces and drawn physical relationships provide relation/context evidence.
individual_correspondences.guard: Interface presence does not entail strict part-of, one function per card or installed topology.

individual_correspondences.why: SOSA Module is a separately defined functional architecture role that might be implemented on physical hardware.
individual_correspondences.guard: It must NOT be read as physical constituent by label or produce phantom hardware/part-of edges.

individual_correspondences.why: SOSA Sensor Component and generic Element can include logical/software as well as physical realizations.
individual_correspondences.guard: Cannot silently equate 'component' with physical module, installed probe or hardware individual.

individual_correspondences.why: RTE describes execution hosting of software, not a physical vehicle/structure.
individual_correspondences.guard: Do not use unqualified platform/host terms to infer location or physical attachment.

individual_correspondences.why: Interaction infrastructure carries logical information exchange between modules.
individual_correspondences.guard: Transport/binding cannot prove a distinct network-visible node, physical cable or original measurement author.

individual_correspondences.why: A procurable unit may implement multiple modules/physical infrastructure elements.
individual_correspondences.guard: Purchase unit or product type is not identical to one module, one model designation, one installed asset or one sensor.

individual_correspondences.why: Source's unqualified 'Platform' can describe sensor device, physical host or computing infrastructure.
individual_correspondences.guard: Only qualified 'SOSA Host Platform' has defensible physical host interpretation.

individual_correspondences.why: SOSA function/interface decomposition is not ISA CIC visible/opaque member exposure.
individual_correspondences.guard: Do not import ISA network member/virtual UCI semantics into SOSA without exact SOSA source evidence.

individual_correspondences.why: System Manager is a defined management module with subfunctions that can qualify generic role/service concepts
individual_correspondences.guard: SOSA managing module is not ISA Controller service role or one-to-one physical component

individual_correspondences.why: SOSA external mission task request and internal assignment resemble issued action request patterns
individual_correspondences.guard: Task Manager interactions are preliminary; no proven user request or physical effect and no exact CSAPI Command mapping

individual_correspondences.why: SOSA task/assignment status and health reporting potentially qualify reported outcome concepts
individual_correspondences.guard: Published status and return codes not independent completed command or mission success

individual_correspondences.why: Native SOSA Capability depends upon as-configured health and tasks/assignments, unlike ISA CCD static declarations
individual_correspondences.guard: No assertion of equal actual mode/capability list or vendor hardware execution

individual_correspondences.why: Finite SOSA Mode concept speaks to known behavior in a discrete mode
individual_correspondences.guard: Do not equate mode to default or current source-reported mode without evidence

individual_correspondences.why: SOSA mode and status message categories can contribute source-specific mode reporting notions
individual_correspondences.guard: Does not establish actual contemporaneous source-reported mode in one of four cases

individual_correspondences.why: Sensor lifecycle/state is explicit separately from condition and health
individual_correspondences.guard: Do not equate SOSA state enum to ISA operating condition property

individual_correspondences.why: Health diagnostics include BIT execution/results and fault reporting
individual_correspondences.guard: No exact native ISA BIT property or actual device diagnostic measurement

individual_correspondences.why: SOSA reports status/health events but ISO-coded property Status report is a distinct message form
individual_correspondences.guard: Syslog notification is not an ISA Status property-value message

individual_correspondences.why: SOSA manager/agent may represent/manage a different component, similar to mediated participation
individual_correspondences.guard: No exact ISA CIC performer/broker/relay semantics, source exposure or virtual UCI mapping

individual_correspondences.why: In-band management interface roles are networked conditional roles
individual_correspondences.guard: SOSA client/server/agent role is not a unique ISA registered network participant

individual_correspondences.why: Distinct notifications about state/status/fault/mode/configuration supply management change evidence
individual_correspondences.guard: Not equal to ISA Administrative event codes, original Observation or all messages actually delivered

individual_correspondences.why: Manager-represented lifecycle at whole sensor and module/PIC level qualifies possible state context
individual_correspondences.guard: State is not source-reported operating mode or proof observed live condition

individual_correspondences.why: PIC/module Lost Communication provides bounded example of diagnostic/availability ambiguity
individual_correspondences.guard: Loss of management path must not be treated as physical sensor health or measured actual failure

individual_correspondences.why: Task assignment statuses offer some reported processing/execution context
individual_correspondences.guard: Not exact ISA current command execution record or verified hardware effect

individual_correspondences.why: SOSA functional modules can process sensory data but are not necessarily the physical observer
individual_correspondences.guard: Functional chain, data ingestor and physical sensing actor must remain separate

individual_correspondences.why: Data product formatting and storage distinguish output stream/report fields and their provenance
individual_correspondences.guard: No exact CSAPI resultSchema, actual Observation or original-to-digital-copy chain

individual_correspondences.why: Security operational state/integrity and alerts may relate to tamper/health concepts
individual_correspondences.guard: Software integrity result/security state does not prove physical tamper condition

individual_correspondences.why: Calibration module describes reference test signal injection separate from recurring observation procedures
individual_correspondences.guard: No actual metrological calibration performed or reusable ObservingProcedure identity

individual_correspondences.why: Host platform interface/nav/time supply site/host-related operational context
individual_correspondences.guard: Time/nav source is not surveyed position of individual instrument or installation history

individual_correspondences.why: Source describes host power flow and functional power conversion/protection distinctions relevant to original case power hold
individual_correspondences.guard: Module reference only: no installed battery, exact voltage, state, control or actual power telemetry

individual_correspondences.why: Possible power status/reference module supports concept of component power condition
individual_correspondences.guard: Does not establish actual ISA Power State property equivalence or real source-state measurement

individual_correspondences.why: Network monitoring and QoS roles are pertinent to connection/reporting-path distinctions
individual_correspondences.guard: No real source-specific radio transmission, timing, CSAPI transfer or network health proof

individual_correspondences.why: Managed capabilities and manager-reported state need separate readiness interpretation
individual_correspondences.guard: A supported functionality is neither a source-attested current ready flag nor a reported actual state

individual_correspondences.why: Preliminary task model contrasts request/state/status/health and actual implementation
individual_correspondences.guard: No source case has authenticated issued, acknowledged, completed, physically verified command sequence

individual_correspondences.why: SOSA DIV-1 mission/management conceptual scope may help categorize output and management fields
individual_correspondences.guard: SOSA DIV-1 is a model layer, not output-field specification or native CSAPI result schema

individual_correspondences.why: Logical quantities and physical format concepts may inform typed measured data
individual_correspondences.guard: Narrative alone cannot establish a native SOSA measurement type/units, actual value or cardinality

individual_correspondences.why: Physical DSDM encoding pointer is related to datatype specification scope
individual_correspondences.guard: Cannot infer DSDM type list from prose or equate to ISA CCD type declarations

individual_correspondences.why: SOSA RTE software profile/configuration has documented fields
individual_correspondences.guard: It is not native ISA Config message, component capability declaration, runtime configuration of all sensors

individual_correspondences.why: Multiple execution environments/implementations illustrate physical vs logical distinctions
individual_correspondences.guard: No physical containment or one module per PIC, sensor or hardware component

individual_correspondences.why: Request-response interactions describe a request to act or get/set operation
individual_correspondences.guard: Not evidence of a source-attested issued command/physical effect

individual_correspondences.why: Response exists as an interaction type after request
individual_correspondences.guard: Response does not independently substantiate completed task or physical effect

individual_correspondences.why: Interconnect roles/families help explain reporting paths and transport differences
individual_correspondences.guard: Source case has no verified SOSA link or real stream implementation

individual_correspondences.why: Signal streams and context metadata are separable from data record output fields
individual_correspondences.guard: No direct SWE DataRecord or CSAPI DataStream/resultSchema equivalence

individual_correspondences.why: SOSA topics identify pub/sub shared structures
individual_correspondences.guard: No equivalent ISA Query object, source UCI or CSAPI Datastream identity

individual_correspondences.why: Event notifications cover operational/management state changes
individual_correspondences.guard: SOSA notification not ISA administrative event code nor original performed Observation

individual_correspondences.guard: ISA presentation negotiation and SOSA Table15.4 stacks not same protocol requirement

individual_correspondences.guard: No native original request ID or ISA response correlation reference established by these pages

individual_correspondences.guard: Publishing data does not prove which physical sensor performed source observation

individual_correspondences.why: SOSA mission/management split and its data models are relevant background to provenance design

individual_correspondences.guard: Does not define original NOAA source observation vs experimental CSAPI copy provenance
